libraries.name: Kokonut UI
libraries.license_note: Open-source repository is MIT; paid/Pro content is separate.
libraries.redistribution: Prefer official public registry installation. Never mirror paid/Pro content.

conflicts: Unplanned daisyUI base alongside a shadcn-derived host

use_when: Polished React/Next.js components or micro-interactions materially improve a product surface.
avoid_when: The existing design system already solves the need or a second visual language would reduce consistency.

libraries.name: React Bits
libraries.license_note: Current free repository uses MIT + Commons Clause.
libraries.redistribution: Never mirror, bundle, sell, sublicense, or redistribute the React Bits component collection from OrchestrUI. Store metadata/instructions and fetch/install from official upstream.

conflicts: Broad use in core product flows

use_when: A landing page, hero or portfolio benefits from one or two distinctive animated effects.
avoid_when: Core product flows, constrained devices, or any plan to redistribute the component library itself.

libraries.name: daisyUI
libraries.redistribution: Respect upstream MIT terms; prefer package installation.

compatibility.base_role: semantic component base and theme system
conflicts: Unplanned second base beside shadcn/Radix or another component system

use_when: The project needs a semantic Tailwind base, themes and forms, or already uses daisyUI.
avoid_when: An established shadcn-derived base already exists and another base system would conflict.

libraries.name: Bklit UI
libraries.license_note: Open-source Bklit UI components are MIT; hosted/premium offerings may have separate terms.
libraries.redistribution: Use official OSS registry; do not copy protected hosted/premium material.

conflicts: A second chart system without explicit ownership

use_when: Charts, dashboards, analytics, gauges or heatmaps are required.
avoid_when: The requirement is unrelated to data visualization.

libraries.name: Anime.js
libraries.redistribution: Use the package under its MIT terms; avoid unnecessary dependency use.

conflicts: Existing motion engine or CSS already covers the effect

use_when: A bespoke timeline, stagger, SVG or scroll choreography cannot be expressed cleanly by existing motion tools.
avoid_when: A simple hover, fade or component-native animation is sufficient.

libraries.name: Rive
libraries.license_note: Official runtimes are open source; individual .riv assets can have separate ownership and usage rights.
libraries.redistribution: Track .riv asset rights separately. Never assume artwork is redistributable.

integration.note: Verify current recommended renderer/runtime before implementation.

use_when: Interactive vector graphics, mascots or state-machine-driven illustrations materially improve the product.
avoid_when: No appropriately licensed .riv asset exists or ordinary DOM/SVG motion is simpler.

libraries.name: Magic UI
libraries.license_note: Open-source repository and official MCP repository are MIT; Pro content is separate.
libraries.redistribution: Use public OSS paths. Never copy Pro content without applicable rights.

conflicts: Overlapping ownership with broad React Bits use

use_when: Animated marketing sections, backgrounds, text effects or visual accents are needed.
avoid_when: Plain product controls are sufficient or the requested item is Pro-only without confirmed rights.
